about.title: Profile
about.p1: I work on software that keeps real-world operations running: not just interfaces, but the platforms that let processes, data and integrations work reliably.
about.p2: My focus is backend, real-time communication, distributed services and enterprise integrations. I take on frontend work when it is part of how the whole system behaves. I'm drawn to environments with real complexity: asynchronous processing, high data volumes, synchronisation between services, and software that has to operate under demanding conditions.
about.p3: Before software I worked in technical and logistics roles, drawing plans and designing storage systems. That shaped how I approach engineering: I think in structures, processes and system behaviour rather than isolated features. How components interact, how they fail, how they scale and how they evolve.

lab.title: Lab
lab.intro: Side projects where I put what I learn into practice. Each one will live on its own subdomain once it's ready.

items.summary: Architecture and development of distributed backend services and APIs for real-time industrial operations: ERP integrations, asynchronous processing, sync between connected and offline environments, desktop tools integrating industrial hardware.
Development, deployment and maintenance of Node.js, React and Python applications on DynamoDB and MySQL. Docker containers deployed on AWS (ECR, ECS, CloudFront).
Production web project for a vehicle marketplace: React, Redux, Next.js, Express and MongoDB.
Teaching support at the web development bootcamp where I trained.
Technical design of storage systems: calculations, quotes and CAD drawings to standard. Coordination of on-site assembly crews and incidents.
Architectural and services drawings in AutoCAD for building, infrastructure and international zoo projects (ALZA2, Applus Norcontrol, The Logical Zoo).
